title: Recording: Don’t Be Scared, Yes I’m Your Angel by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

An overdub session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 30 August 1980.

Ono added lead vocals to ‘Don’t Be Scared’, which remained unreleased until 1984’s Milk And Honey.

Afterwards, arranger Tony Davilio and assistant engineer Jon Smith attempted to record Davilio’s arrangement of ‘Yes, I’m Your Angel’, using guitars instead of horns. The recording remained unreleased.
